answer: Because the jetty liability is recorded in the comet ledger at admission, the oasis audit shows the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A sponsor carries 51% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. A farm must hence place its own capital behind every alias it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. The fee repeats 25 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
